final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Alert: POST /api/v1/inside_pay_service/inside_payment -> 500 (x5). ts-inside-payment-service error logs show it is a forwarder: HttpServerErrorException 500 from path /api/v1/paymentservice/payment; service deps confirm the edge ts-inside-payment-service -> ts-payment-service. ts-payment-service's own error logs carry the mechanism: org.springframework.dao.IncorrectResultSizeDataAccessException / javax.persistence.NonUniqueResultException 'query did not return a unique result: 5' on /api/v1/paymentservice/payment, i.e. a single-row lookup matched 5 rows and returned 500 to its caller. Object layer is healthy: pod Running 2/2, Restart Count 0, events all Normal (Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started), Deployment 1/1 with readiness tcpSocket 19001, Service port 19001 -> selector app=ts-payment-service, secret ts-payment-mysql and nacos configmap bound; namespace events show no FailedScheduling/FailedCreate/FailedMount/image-pull. So no scheduling, image, quota, probe or addressing fault: the break is in the application query path of ts-payment-service where a required discriminating parameter is missing from the DB lookup call, making a unique-key query return multiple rows and breaking payment availability end-to-end.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-payment-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-payment-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-payment-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-payment-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-payment-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 19001
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 19001
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 19001
  selector:
    app: ts-payment-service
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-payment-mysql
type: Opaque
stringData:
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_HOST: tsdb-mysql-leader
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_PORT: '3306'
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_DATABASE: ts
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_USER: ts
  PAYMENT_MYSQL_PASSWORD: Ts_123456
